asked.item: Why cleanTranscript=true on GET /v2/source-resolutions-v3/:id does not remove timestamps
Is there a REST parameter named diff to remove timestamps

verdict.reason: The help pages state that cleanTranscript is not a REST query parameter and that REST users must remove timestamps in their own workflow, which answers the customer's question about the REST endpoint.

steps.text: cleanTranscript is not a REST query parameter or an MCP tool argument.
For REST, retrieve the completed content first, then remove transcript timestamps in your agent or workflow if requested.
Sending cleanTranscript to this endpoint will not change the response.
